compiled_by: demo pipeline (manual curation from cited public sources)

corridor.name: Strait of Hormuz / Gulf of Oman
corridor.note: Bounding box used for the AISStream subscription and the detector. It covers the strait plus the Gulf of Oman approach where the replay incident occurred.

dataset: HISTORICAL REPLAY — documented public incident near the Strait of Hormuz

confidence.collision_occurred: HIGH — confirmed by vessel owner statement, UAE Coast Guard evacuation reporting, and multiple news outlets.
confidence.position: MEDIUM — single-source coordinates (TankerTrackers.com via Lokmat Times); not independently verified.
confidence.sts_transfer: NOT APPLICABLE — this was a collision, not an STS transfer. No STS is claimed.

events.context: The collision occurred during a period of reported GPS/electronic interference in the Gulf region. A maritime information centre advisory noted allegations of electronic interference around Bandar Abbas. GPS interference is CONTEXT, not a proven cause of this collision.
events.detection_notes: If this incident had been observed through the live pipeline, the detector rules in pipeline/detect.py would NOT have flagged it as an STS candidate (vessels were under way at 13.1 and 4.8 knots, not stationary side-by-side). It is included to demonstrate the event-table + evidence + provenance UI and the GPS-interference context layer, not as a detection success.
events.event_type: collision (documented incident — NOT an STS event)
events.location_description: Gulf of Oman, approx. 15 nautical miles off Fujairah / 24 nautical miles east of Khor Fakkan, UAE — just outside the Strait of Hormuz.
events.official_assessment: Owner (Frontline) and UKMTO assessed it as a navigational incident, not related to the regional conflict. UAE energy ministry later cited preliminary information pointing to a navigational misjudgement by one vessel.
events.outcome: Fire on both vessels. All 24 crew of ADALYNN evacuated by UAE Coast Guard / National Guard to Khor Fakkan. No injuries and no pollution reported at the time (per owner statement and UAE Coast Guard reporting).
events.position_source: TankerTrackers.com incident report (coordinates as quoted in the Lokmat Times article below). Independent position verification was NOT performed by this demo.

shadow_fleet_claim.claim: Some media reports described ADALYNN as part of a 'shadow fleet' / 'dark fleet' moving Russian oil.
shadow_fleet_claim.handling: This demo does NOT label ADALYNN as sanctioned, and does NOT claim any sanctions-list match. No official sanctions list was checked for this demo. A vessel must never be labelled 'sanctioned' without an official list match.

sources.publisher: Lokmat Times (quoting TankerTrackers.com incident report incl. coordinates, IMOs, speeds, cargo, destination)

SAFETY4SEA — collision unrelated to Israel-Iran conflict; crew evacuation details
Marine Log — report describing ADALYNN as a 'shadow fleet' tanker (characterization UNVERIFIED, see above)
